# Handoff Acknowledged

## Summary

| Model | Tuning μ/min | Lockbox μ/min | Worst MDD |
|-------|-------------|---------------|-----------|
| **Champion** (v5_latest) | 1.904 / 0.431 | 1.793 / 1.134 | -9.31% |
| Last PASS (macro_alpha_shadow) | 1.762 / 0.051 | 1.793 / 1.347 | -11.18% |

### Observations
- **Champion retains crown** — stronger tuning minimum (0.43 vs 0.05) and better worst-case MDD (-9.3% vs -11.2%)
- **Candidate's edge**: Higher lockbox minimum (1.35 vs 1.13) suggests better tail stability on out-of-sample
- **No inconclusive experiments** — clean slate for next batch

## Recommended Actions

Execute the provided pipeline commands in sequence:

```bash
# 1. Run module-level experiments & promote best
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidate combinations
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate diagnostic report for next iteration
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- Tuning minimum on next candidates (the 0.05 on macro_alpha_shadow suggests a fold with near-zero or negative Sharpe)
- If MDD continues to degrade, consider adding MDD regularization to the objective

Ready to proceed or need deeper analysis on any component?
